description: Header file defining interfaces and a template class for synchronous communication channels, including message framing, serialization, deserialization, and callback mechanisms within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: IOutbound
classes.description: Interface for outbound messages with serialization and reload capabilities.

classes.name: IInbound
classes.description: Interface for inbound message response handling with deserialization and completion status.

classes.name: SynchronousChannelType
classes.description: Template class implementing a synchronous communication channel with message queue, framing, and callback management.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Callback invoked when outbound data is updated or status changes.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes outbound message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Reloads or resets the outbound message state.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming byte stream into inbound message response.

methods.name: IsCompleted
methods.description: Checks if inbound message response is complete.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Sends a message and optionally waits for a response within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Queues a message for sending with optional callback and response handling.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events, triggering reevaluation.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Pure virtual method to deserialize incoming data.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Removes expired frames from the queue and notifies callbacks.

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Triggers reevaluation of message queue state.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Waits for a request to complete or timeout, managing the message queue accordingly.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Serializes and sends message data over the channel.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives and processes incoming data, updating message states.
